versions.changelog: Names SEOmatic and the approve-first rule; exact tool and task names.

Initial release of seomatic-content-brief—write data-driven content briefs and score drafts for SEO optimization.

- Builds briefs using live SERP data, site search performance, and internal link recommendations.
- Analyzes keyword volume, intent, competitor coverage, and existing site rankings to guide focus.
- Highlights "must cover" topics, gaps (angles), and questions to answer based on top results.
- Includes draft scoring to ensure all requirements are met before publishing.
- Supports content creation workflows and integration with SEOmatic services.
